title: A Man On Live TV Said He Was L, Then Dropped Dead . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Death Note episode 2, a man on live TV claims to be the great detective L, and drops dead seconds after Jack writes his name. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #recap #animerewind

segments.say: Jack writes one name, and a man drops dead on live TV in front of *millions*.
To see how it got here, go back to a man on live TV who swears he will stop *Kira*.
Jack watches. Why would the greatest detective ever show his *face*?
Then a name flashes on the screen. Lind L. Tailor.
Jack does not wait. He writes it down and counts the *seconds*.
Seconds pass and nothing happens. Then the man clutches his *chest*.
Then the screen goes dark. One white *letter* glows on it.
A cold voice says, I am the real L. That man was a *decoy*.
Lind L. Tailor was a criminal on death row. L planned it *all*.
L says Kira kills with a face and a *name*.
The broadcast only aired in the Kanto *region*.
Kira killed him within seconds, so Kira must live in that *region*.
Kira is not hiding in some far country. He is *close*.
Jack freezes. L just shrank the entire world down to one small *map*.
